strongest_angle: A nearly eight-year legal battle between AEG Presents and Danny Wimmer Presents over rock festival rights is set for a February 2027 jury trial in Los Angeles Superior Court, following a rejected $18.9 million buyout offer.

key_facts.fact: AEG Presents and Danny Wimmer Presents are scheduled for a jury trial in February 2027 at the Los Angeles Superior Court.
Court filings reveal that AEG Presents previously offered $18.9 million to either buy out the interest of Danny Wimmer Presents in Rock on the Range and Carolina Rebellion or sell its own stake.
The legal dispute began in November 2018 when AEG Presents filed a 25-count lawsuit against Danny Wimmer Presents in the Los Angeles Superior Court.
The partnership between AEG Presents and Danny Wimmer Presents previously co-promoted the Rock on the Range and Carolina Rebellion music festivals.
